🇬🇧 This week I had the privilege of visiting BAE Systems at Warton in my capacity as lead member — and I came away hugely proud that this is on our doorstep in Lancashire.

✈️ World-leading innovation: Warton supports the RAF Typhoon fleet, leads the UK's work on the next-generation Global Combat Air Programme (with Japan and Italy), and designed Brontanax — the UK's first uncrewed combat aircraft.

👷 Thousands of jobs: around 12,000 people across BAE's Lancashire sites — one of the very largest employers in the county, if not THE largest. Highly skilled, well paid, secure work, with opportunity right across the site and staff retention that speaks for itself.

🤝 A brilliant welcome: my thanks to the team for their hospitality and for being so open with every question we asked.

And let's be honest — in this day and age, with global threats what they are, BAE isn't only a local employer. The people at Warton are helping to protect our country and our allies. Backing BAE means backing Lancashire jobs AND national security at the same time.

We're lucky to have them. Now government must back our combat air industry with the orders and investment to secure this work for the next generation. 🇬🇧
